rows.grounds: mantra formula spoken as one fused unit

items.question: What does the practitioner declare and request in this Kaula light-mantra?
premises: The mantra identifies the self with light.
It asks to become stainless and sinless.
It closes with the offering word svaha.
items.inference: The practitioner affirms luminous identity and prays for purified becoming.
uncertainties: Whether the phrase is one token or a fused mantra string.
items.plain_english: May I become light, stainless, and sinless—svaha.
